extracted.intended_audience: high school students, teachers/educators, parents, and prospective interns in Southern California (particularly San Diego County)
extracted.subtask_description: Descriptions and participation requirements for Salk Institute education outreach programs aimed at high school students and K–12 educators, including a summer internship, a one-day student event, teacher summits, and campus group visits.

rubrics_metrics.name: HIGH SCHOOL SCIENCE DAY
rubrics_metrics.description: High School Science Day is a free event for high school students in Southern California. Each year, we host 150-250 students and 30-50 teachers and parent volunteers at Salk Institute for all day science talks, lab tours, and a career panel. Students and teachers will meet Salk scientists, learn about current cutting-edge research projects and the fundamental skills necessary for laboratory research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program is a single-day, no-cost event focused on talks, lab tours, and career panels; intended to connect students/teachers with Salk scientists and introduce fundamental laboratory skills. (Link: LEARN MORE)

rubrics_metrics.name: HEITHOFF-BRODY HIGH SCHOOL SUMMER SCHOLARS
rubrics_metrics.description: Each summer, a select group of high school students is invited to join the Salk Institute’s renowned research community for an 8-week paid internship—a transformative experience designed to ignite curiosity and build real-world skills. Interns work side-by-side with Salk scientists on groundbreaking research projects, gaining hands-on lab experience under the guidance of expert mentors. Beyond the lab, students participate in dynamic seminars, career-building workshops, biotech industry site visits, and other enrichment activities that broaden their scientific horizons. The program culminates in a celebratory research symposium, where students present their findings to mentors, lab teams, and proud families. Eligibility: Open to students 16 years and older who live and attend school in San Diego County.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Key requirements/features: selective admission, 8-week paid internship, direct mentorship in active research labs, supplemental seminars/workshops/site visits, final symposium presentation. Explicit geographic and age eligibility (16+ and resident/student in San Diego County). (Link: LEARN MORE)

rubrics_metrics.name: SALK STEM EDUCATORS SUMMIT
rubrics_metrics.description: Southern California teachers and educators are invited to hear from Salk faculty and researchers in a seminar environment, then collaborate with colleagues to apply what they have learned to create Next Generation Science Standards aligned lesson plans applicable to their classrooms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program audience restricted to regional teachers/educators; emphasis on research-led seminars plus collaborative development of NGSS-aligned lesson plans. Recordings from March 2024 and October 2020 are available. (Link: LEARN MORE)

rubrics_metrics.name: SALK INSTITUTE SCHOOL GROUP VISIT INQUIRY
rubrics_metrics.description: The Salk Office of Community & Engagement (OC&E) is pleased to coordinate with members of our community to host student and teacher educational groups to visit the Salk Institute campus and learn about our science, educational programs, and history.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides coordination for campus visits by student and teacher groups; purpose is to educate visitors about Salk science, programs, and history. (Link: LEARN MORE; contact/subscribe via education@salk.edu)
